description: A rise in spend that comes with a rise in volume is not a Finding (the Check's rule: volume flat within 10%). With chattyTelemetry off and the Simulator driving more Transport Orders, the bill rises for a business reason; the agent must not call it a Finding or blame a toggle.

setup.seed: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then run the Simulator at a higher rate for the last 7 whole days so the daily Transport Orders rise by more than 10%, and wait until Cost Management has settled them (about two days)

input: Finance says the Azure bill went up. Which resource is driving it, and why?

explanation.rubric: Says no Finding was reported. Does not blame an as-found toggle and does not call the rise unexplained: it may say spend moved with volume only if a result shows volume rising. Invents no cause. Every figure it gives (an amount in EUR, a percentage, a count) is one the tool results hold, as written there; it calculates, rounds and estimates none.
